name: markdown-as-typed
title: Markdown As Typed
description: Stored Markdown as the person typed it — markdownAsTyped keeps real formatting, drops the escapes the writer added only to keep plain text from reading as syntax (\_\_init\_\_ → __init__), turns hard breaks into newlines, and keeps code byte for byte. Pure strings, server-safe.

meta.whenToUse: Handing a person's stored message to a reader that isn't a Markdown renderer: a model's input, a chat bubble, a plain-text notification.
meta.whenNotToUse: Anything parsed back into an editor — keep the stored Markdown, which round-trips.
